issues.link_text: Priority of Service for Support Services and Child

steps: Step 1: Open Adobe Acrobat Pro DC
Step 2: Open the Tags panel (View > Show/Hide > Navigation Panes > Tags)
Step 3: Navigate to page 2 in the document
Step 4: In the Tags panel, expand the structure tree
Step 5: Look for a TOC or TOCI element containing 'Purpose ......................'
Step 6: Find the Reference element for this link
Step 7: Right-click the Reference element
Step 8: Select 'New Tag' from the context menu
Step 9: Choose 'Link' as the tag type
Step 10: Drag the Reference element into the newly created Link tag
Step 11: Right-click the Link tag and select 'Properties'
Step 12: In the 'Alternate Text' field, enter: 'Go to page 3'
Step 13: Click OK to save
Step 14: The link is now properly structured!
